scope: v0.6.0 current source checks; does not certify frozen artifacts, actual browser accessibility trees, physical controllers or native execution. Focused controller/practice checks are subsets of the root total, not additional unique tests.

mise exec node@22.22.2 -- npm run format:check
mise exec node@22.22.2 -- npm run format:native:check

mise exec node@22.22.2 -- node --test authoring/motion-lab/test-ability.mjs authoring/motion-lab/test-animation.mjs authoring/motion-lab/test-collection.mjs authoring/motion-lab/test-grid-motion.mjs authoring/motion-lab/test-motion.mjs
mise exec node@22.22.2 -- node --test game/test/controller-preview.test.mjs game/test/controller-lab.test.mjs
